description.en: Jiacheng Liu is a master’s student at Beihang University studying how drivers interact with automated driving systems.
description.zh: 刘嘉成，北京航空航天大学控制科学与工程硕士生，研究自动驾驶场景中的人机交互。

eyebrow.zh: 北京航空航天大学 · 硕士研究生

en: In automated driving, how do people decide when to trust AI and when to take over?
How can people and intelligent systems share tasks and make reliable decisions?
I study driver trust, behavior and situation awareness.
zh: 在自动驾驶中，人怎样判断何时信任人工智能、何时接管？
人和智能系统如何分配任务、共同作出可靠的决策？
我关注驾驶员的信任、行为与情境意识。

trust_question.en: When do drivers trust automation, and when do they take over?
trust_question.zh: 驾驶员什么时候会信任自动驾驶，又什么时候会接管？

project_message.zh: 从脑电信号到驾驶监控，来看看这些项目吧。

contact_message.en: Studying how people and AI work together? Jiacheng would love to hear from you.
contact_message.zh: 也在研究人和人工智能怎样协作？欢迎找嘉成聊聊。

glance_title.en: I study how people and intelligent systems perceive situations, share tasks and make reliable decisions together.
glance_title.zh: 我研究人和智能系统如何共同感知、分配任务，并作出可靠的决策。

project_intro.en: Driver monitoring, aviation oxygen systems and EEG-based risk detection.
project_intro.zh: 智能驾驶监控、航空供氧与基于脑电的交互风险预警。

portrait_alt.en: Jiacheng Liu on a mountain trail.
portrait_alt.zh: 刘嘉成在山间步道上的照片。

bio_education.en: I’m Jiacheng Liu, a master’s student in Control Science and Engineering at Beihang University. I also studied Aircraft Quality and Reliability at Beihang as an undergraduate.
bio_education.zh: 我是刘嘉成，北京航空航天大学控制科学与工程专业硕士生，本科就读于北航飞行器质量与可靠性专业。

bio_research.en: I study human–AI interaction in automated driving, particularly how drivers understand, trust and work with automation. I plan to extend this work to embodied AI and logical reasoning, exploring how people understand an agent’s actions and reasoning.
bio_research.zh: 我目前研究自动驾驶场景中的人机交互，关注驾驶员如何理解、信任并与自动化系统协作。今后，我希望把这些问题拓展到更多具身智能和逻辑人工智能场景，研究人如何理解智能体的行动与推理。
